title: Hundred Years' War
summary: An intermittent conflict between England and France, which by convention began in 1337 when Philip VI confiscated the English-held duchy of Guyenne. Disputes over English lands in France and the French succession drove it. French victories, notably Castillon in 1453, left England holding only Calais and strengthened the French crown.

as_recorded.value: By convention the war is said to have started on May 24, 1337
The Hundred Years' War (1337-1453) was an intermittent conflict
